item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a reliable 2024 source in the searched material that directly tied Sheikh Hasina or immediate family members to specific named assets, bribes, shell companies, or recorded hidden holdings.\n\nThe evidence base is mostly systemic and inferential: crony capitalism, politicized enforcement, and corruption-prone mega-projects, not a direct forensic trace of private enrichment.","evidence":[{"title":"BPPA says e-GP and e-PMIS improved transparency, efficiency, and competition","publisher":"Bangladesh Public Procurement Authority","date":"July 24, 2024","url":"https://www.bppa.gov.bd/about-cptu/public-procurement-reform.html","summary":"Mandatory e-procurement is evidence of a more rules-based procurement channel that can reduce room for kickbacks or favoritism. It is not proof against enrichment, but it is the clearest institutional counterweight I found.","question_ids":["7B.4","6B.9","6B.10"]},{"title":"Bangladesh receives $900 million World Bank financing to increase economic and urban resilience","publisher":"World Bank","date":"June 21, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/21/bangladesh-receives-900-million-world-bank-financing-to-increase-economic-and-urban-resilience-for-sustainable-growth","summary":"The package explicitly includes procurement reform, banking oversight, and tax changes. That points to some anti-rent institutional repair, though it is reform intent rather than proof of clean practice.","question_ids":["7B.4","6B.9","6B.10"]},{"title":"Bangladesh reaffirms commitment to nuclear non-proliferation, peaceful use","publisher":"Dhaka Tribune","date":"April 30, 2024","url":"https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/foreign-affairs/345281/bangladesh-reaffirms-commitment-to-nuclear-non-proliferation-peaceful-use","summary":"Officials said Bangladesh would maintain transparency, safety, and IAEA-backed safeguards for nuclear plants. This is narrow evidence of some disciplined administration in a high-risk domain, not evidence of personal enrichment.","question_ids":["7B.4","6B.9"]},{"title":"AL govt created lawless economy","publisher":"The Daily Star","date":"October 31, 2024","url":"https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/al-govt-created-lawless-economy-3741796","summary":"A white-paper lead said authoritarian practices produced crony capitalism and a nexus of bureaucrats, political leaders, and business interests that captured public organizations. This is strong evidence of broad patronage and elite capture consistent with profit-from-office dynamics.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3","6B.9","6B.10"]},{"title":"Rooppur power plant was AL govt’s white elephant: energy sector experts","publisher":"TBS News","date":"October 5, 2024","url":"https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/energy/rooppur-power-plant-was-al-govts-white-elephant-energy-sector-experts-958801","summary":"Experts described Rooppur as mismanaged and corruption-linked. This is strong indirect evidence that major state spending was vulnerable to patronage rather than neutral public value, though it still does not name a personal enrichment trail.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3","6B.9","6B.10"]},{"title":"Billions at Stake: Unveiling the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant’s Spiraling Costs and Corruption","publisher":"Bangla Outlook","date":"April 23, 2024","url":"https://en.banglaoutlook.org/news/1099","summary":"The piece alleges major cost inflation and politically linked ancillary contracts around Rooppur. If accurate, this is the clearest claim-level signal that contracts around a flagship project were exposed to patronage and hidden conflicts.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3"]},{"title":"Bangladesh: Freedom in the World 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/bangladesh/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House said corruption was endemic, anticorruption enforcement was politicized, and ruling-party control over state resources created coercive economic power. That is strong evidence of a system where office can plausibly be monetized through access and influence.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3","7B.1","6B.9","6B.10"]},{"title":"Bangladesh: Freedom on the Net 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/bangladesh/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House described blocked news sites, throttled communications, and a partisan information environment.
